Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WizardLM: Empowering Large Pre-Trained Language Models to Follow Complex Instructions (2304.12244v3) · paper method: Evol-Instruct separates instruction evolution, response generation and elimination of failed evolutions; in-depth prompts add difficulty while in-breadth prompts expand instruction diversity.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WizardLM: Empowering Large Pre-Trained Language Models to Follow Complex Instructions (2304.12244v3) · paper method: The WizardEval human study uses 218 instructions spanning 29 skills and domains and recruits 10 annotators for source-hidden, shuffled-response comparison using five listed evaluation aspects.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WizardLM: Empowering Large Pre-Trained Language Models to Follow Complex Instructions (2304.12244v3) · paper method: WizardLM v3 starts from 52k Alpaca instructions, runs four evolution rounds using Azure OpenAI ChatGPT, obtains a 250k instruction pool, and samples 70k examples for main LLaMA 13B fine-tuning.
